title: Julie B NDE 22687
content: I was twenty-one. My husband and I just finished making love, when all of a sudden I found myself in the worst pain I've ever been in. I felt like I was going to throw up and have diarrhea all at the same time. I went to bathroom. As the pain increased, I fell forward. My husband caught me and laid me down on the floor. He left to call 911, that's when all of a sudden I was standing on green grass. I believe I looked forward and saw my dead grandmother and my dead cousin. I felt no more pain; there was a brightness behind them. I felt happy, loved and realized I must have died. I said wait, I can't be dead I haven't had any children yet! Then I was back in my body, I awoke still with pain, my husband helped me to the couch and waited for 911. 911 only took a couple of minutes, but by the time they reached me the pain, and other symptoms were gone. I felt one hundred percent better. The paramedics took my blood pressure it was normal. I was normal, just as if nothing ever happened. We went on and had three beautiful girls, all healthy.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening. I'm not sure. I had been using speed. I believe that is why my body shut down.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I saw my dead grandma and cousin, and knew I must have died.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes There was a light behind my dead grandmother and cousin. It was very bright and felt warm.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I do remember feeling warm like the sun was all around me.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt such love. No pain. Happiness and peace.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I knew I wanted children and hadn't had any as of that time.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I didn't feel like I had any choice. But I really wanted to have a baby.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I didn't feel like I had any choice. But I really wanted to have a baby. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Moderate I knew there was a God but didn't study or go to church
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I used to fear death before this happened to me. Not anymore.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I used to fear death before this happened to me. Not anymore. After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The worst part was the pain before I went. The best part was seeing my relatives, and feeling like I had made it to heaven.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I told my husband right away. He knew I wasn't lying, but he just ignored my experience.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: It's a very embarrassing way to have this type of out of body experience. This is why I don't go around telling everyone.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: All questions seemed to the point.
